# HireKrkeDekho

> HireKrkeDekho is an AI-powered engineering career advisory, technical benchmarking, and daily coding contest platform designed for software engineers, developers, and tech professionals in India.

## Key Links
- [Home & Platform Overview](https://hirekrkedekho.in/): Next-generation AI career roadmap engine and daily technical benchmarking contest.
- [AI Career Advisor](https://hirekrkedekho.in/consultation): Interactive 1-on-1 career consultation tailored to tech stacks, salary bands (LPA), and Indian tech hubs.
- [Daily Tech Contest](https://hirekrkedekho.in/#ai_race): 15 rapid-fire technical challenges with 15-second countdowns and live leaderboards.
- [Privacy Policy](https://hirekrkedekho.in/privacy-policy): Platform data security and candidate privacy commitments.

## Core Capabilities
- **Tri-Factor Matching Engine**: Calibrates career recommendations and real-time open roles across three dimensions: Degree, Years of Experience, and Core Technical Stack.
- **AI Career Advisor**: Conversational advisor providing structured role analysis, salary bands (LPA), required skills, and tailored 3-week preparation guides for Indian tech hubs (Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Gurgaon, Noida, Mumbai).
- **Daily AI Race**: Daily 15-question rapid-fire technical benchmarking contest testing algorithms, data structures, and system design with server-timed anti-cheat and live leaderboards.
